result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active unmatched contributors.

**Change:** `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams()` (around line 727). The remainder condition now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped, and configured teams still get all their members.

Blank latest-commit dates count as active because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank dates, so nobody is dropped for missing data.

**Verification:** `ContributorTest` passes (1 run, 0 failures). There is no existing landscape test in `codeanalyzer`, so the remainder logic itself is untested. I did not add a test.

**Not changed:** the existing `!remainder.getMembers().contains(email)` check compares a `ContributorRepositories` list against a string, so it is always true. I left it alone because it is outside this task. Nothing is committed.
